# Datamining PTS: Season 23 "Blood x Rust" All Rewards

![Datamining PTS: Season 23 `Blood x Rust` All Rewards](/uploads/572_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update 12/02/2025]** Rewards finally updated, Kollektron information added to list

On the current "Burning Springs" PTS, some rewards for next season 23 have already been received in the data that I can already show you. You can also find the current complete list of rewards here in the article.

The title of next season is apparently "**Blood x Rust**", since that's what the "End of Season" wall art was named. I think that goes very well with Burning Springs.

Here you can see the list of rewards for Season 23, including the preview images. As soon as more pictures become available, I will add them here. Also take a look at the corresponding video, where I explain a few more details about the items.
